QuestInfo.name: [Convergence] Under Ereve
QuestInfo.0:
#bNeinheart#k tells you an urgent matter has arisen that requires your attention.
Hurry and meet him at the #bOutpost#k.
QuestInfo.2:
#bWill#k is being held somewhere beneath #bEreve#k, questioned by #bGrendel the Really Old#k.
Before you had a chance to meet with either of them, you were startled by a deafening roar.
QuestInfo.1:
You met up with #bNeinheart#k to learn some crucial information about what happened to #bWill the King of Spiders#k after the #rBlack Mage#k fell.
#bWill#k is being questioned by #bGrendel the Really Old#k. 
Travel with #bNeinheart#k to see #bGrendel the Really Old#k and #bWill#k.
